Kevin Trudeau's close friend was a performer called the Amazing Kreskin - a regular on The Tonight Show, famous for one specific trick.

Before every show, his check for that night's performance was hidden somewhere in the building. If he couldn't find it, he didn't get paid.

One night it was folded up and tucked under his own dentures. Another night it was frozen solid inside a tub of ice cream in the restaurant kitchen. He found both.

Professional magicians, including David Copperfield, admitted they couldn't explain how. Kevin's answer: it wasn't a trick. It was just his mind.

Michael Jordan has made more game-winning shots than anyone in NBA history.

He's also missed more game-winning shots than anyone in NBA history.

Kevin Trudeau's point: everyone is born to win, but conditioned to lose - taught to worry about missing instead of just taking the shot. You miss 100% of the shots you never take.

The difference between a winner and everyone else isn't a perfect record. It's that a winner doesn't call a miss a loss. There's no losing - you either win, or you learn.

What shot have you been too scared to take?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #michaeljordan #successmindset #wealthmindset #motivation

A friend of Kevin Trudeau's sat down with his accountant in the middle of one of America's worst recessions.

The accountant read down the list: oil and gas, a record year. Real estate, up 5%. Restaurant business, great strides. Concrete business, flat - didn't drop at all.

The accountant finally asked: how do you explain all this success in a recession? His answer: 'I just chose not to participate.'

You can choose to go along with the conditions around you, or you can become the cause of your results instead of just the effect of everyone else's.

What recession are you currently choosing to participate in?

There's an old story Kevin Trudeau tells: a dog is lying on a porch, and every few minutes it whimpers like it's in pain, then does nothing about it.

Someone finally asks why. 'He's sleeping on a nail.' 'Then why won't he move?' 'Because it doesn't hurt him enough to bother.'

That's most people's whole life. Step one of Kevin's manifesting formula: get specific about what you're actually fed up with - you need a nail painful enough to make you move.

Then: decide exactly what you want. Feel yourself already holding it. Then let go of needing it to happen on any schedule.

Ten seconds, repeated fifty times a day - that's the whole practice.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #mindset #yourwishisyourcommand #lawofattraction #goals

Liberace was the biggest entertainer in America in the 1950s - the number one show on television.

On air, he held up a book: The Magic of Believing by Claude Bristol. His own words: 'I was nothing until I read this book. Then I started believing in myself.'

Kevin Trudeau's point isn't the book itself - it's that belief has to come before the evidence, every time. You have to see what you want and believe you're worth having it before any of it shows up.

What are you waiting for proof of, before you'll let yourself believe it?
